newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-DE BILDE UNAVAILABLE FOR PSV THIS SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DE BILDE UNAVAILABLE FOR PSV THIS SEASON.

text.p: World soccer body FIFA have told PSV Eindhoven they must wait until next season before fielding Belgian Gilles De Bilde, who moved to the Dutch league leaders from Anderlecht on Tuesday.
Striker De Bilde is suspended until March 31 after he assaulted another player in a Belgian league game.
But Het Volk newspaper said on Thursday it had been told by FIFA that De Bilde could only obtain a licence to play in the Netherlands after his suspension.
By then the Dutch transfer period will already have ended so that De Bilde cannot play for PSV for the rest of the season. The Dutch transfer period ends on March 7.
The Belgian soccer union imposed the ban on De Bilde earlier this month after he struck Aalst's Krist Porte, breaking his eye socket and nose, during a match in December.
De Bilde, voted Belgian Player of the Year in 1994, also faces trial for allegedly hitting two male nurses in 1995 when he was denied access to his father in hospital.
